name: r3-trusted-publisher

repositoryOptIn.name: KIRARI_R3_PUBLISHER_ENABLED
repositoryOptIn.purpose: Both uncredentialed source and credentialed jobs require explicit true before any Environment job can start; post-merge schedules must not auto-create an Environment.
repositoryOptIn.enablePrerequisites: separately approved trusted-base establishment and App/credential/test setup; activation remains separately blocked

secrets.name: KIRARI_R3_PUBLISHER_PRIVATE_KEY
consumers: reviewed publisher and revocation App-token mint steps only

secretSetupPrerequisites: the exact implementation is separately authorized and established on a trusted base; PR136 authorization cannot authorize a new implementation merge
the Owner has separately approved App/installation/key/Environment setup and the exact isolated test target
the dedicated App installation and benign App check provenance have been read back
the exact ruleset has been separately authorized, applied, and authenticated-read back
main is protected by the App-bound required check and trusted-root path gate
final merge admission and required-check success are independently reviewed and live verified; revocation schedules alone are insufficient

workflowJob.sourcePredicateLocation: job.if before the Environment-bearing job starts
requiredSourcePredicate: action is requested, in_progress, or completed
completed upstream conclusion is success or a supported failure that must invalidate prior success; pending events have no conclusion
authenticated workflow run title binds exact PR number, candidate head, and base
only the latest run and attempt for the exact PR/head/base may publish
requested/in_progress events invalidate prior success with an App check left in_progress
upstream head repository ID equals this repository ID
workflowJob.reason: workflow_run uses the default-branch GITHUB_REF even when triggered by an untrusted upstream run; authenticated source preflight must reject that run before the Environment job

custody.preActivationKeyPlacement: Owner-controlled secure local custody only; no persistent key in repository Actions
custody.warning: A workflow referencing an absent Environment can create an unprotected empty Environment; never dispatch credentialed setup implicitly

revocationJob.source: authenticated current main workflow definition SHA and repository identity
